card.name: Starting dose and injection site wording
card.fires_on: The word "starting" after "recommended" before dose or dosage, and "injection" before "site(s)" in dosing instructions. It also fires on some other mid-phrase words in label text.

modes.label: Recommended starting dose
modes.description: The word "starting" right after "recommended" and before dose or dosage.
modes.example: The recommended<< starting>> dose of JAKAFI is

modes.label: Injection site
modes.description: The word "injection" just before "site" in rotation or administration instructions.
modes.example: Rotate<< injection>> sites to reduce risk of lipodyst

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Inside a drug or class name, or a number, where the next piece continues the term.

card.writes: It seems to favor a next word that joins or continues a phrase, such as "and" or "&", across several languages.
card.plain: It marks a word in a dosing phrase that is about to be followed by "dose" or "site".
